guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: Frontend errors surge (z=+432) and the worst traces show error spans only in checkoutservice and frontend, so the fault lies at or below checkoutservice; the only resource anomaly among its callees is currencyservice_socket (3 to 5.09, z=+13.91). However, the digest has no direct evidence on checkoutservice itself, and the one paymentservice error log is unexplained, so the choice of service and fault type is tentative.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect checkoutservice's outbound connections to currencyservice and paymentservice (connection pool, socket state, error logs), and restart the affected pod only if connections are confirmed stuck. Do not take any destructive action before that check.
